method.warmup: One complete flight per case; excluded from measured percentiles.
method.measuredRounds: max(2, ceil(500 / warmup windows)) per case
method.controllerScope: Current-state feedback, bounded quaternion PD, exact 2ms fixed-pose braking preview when enabled, geometric allocation.
method.stepScope: Controller plus 10 official MuJoCo WASM substeps, valves, gas, fan, contact criteria, snapshot.
method.casesMeaning: Eight prior development cases; repeated timing rounds are not independent evaluation samples.

limits: Node measurements on this machine, not browser Worker scheduling or hard realtime.
Observed p99/max do not bound WCET or guarantee every 20ms deadline.
Ideal simulator state; excludes IMU noise, sensor fusion, communications and real actuator hardware.
Failures remain failures irrespective of computation speed.
